description: Requires a JWT. HISTORY — a claim earns nothing since the Tailwind retired (2026-10-09 22:00 UTC); nobody is paid for a post. Puts a campaign bonus on one of YOUR collected posts (current round, reached ≥ 2.0 X-weighted, not copied or deleted, carrying the campaign's tag + words). Already claimed that day? It MOVES to this post — still one bonus a day. Optional campaign = a slug from `campaigns`.
